angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 169,194 km at 32.09 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 31.1664 +/- 0.0149 mas (same row, RUWE 1.13): 32.09 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.2432 +/- 0.0063 solar radii from Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6002 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract): 169,194 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.2101 +/- 0.0049 solar masses from Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6002 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3229 +/- 77 K from Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6002 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6002 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6002.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.989, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6002 (pscomppars): spectral type M3.5+/-0.5, from Ghachoui et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, G 125-49: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6002 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.18 dex, from Ghachoui et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6002 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.23508, from Ghachoui et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6002 (pscomppars): age 6.35 Gyr, from Ghachoui et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
